text.cs: The Kuchlbauer Tower is an observation tower designed by Austrian architect Friedensreich Hundertwasser on the grounds of the Kuchlbauer brewery in Abensberg, a town in Lower Bavaria.

text.cs: Abusina or Abusena was a Roman castra, and later vicus of town, of the Roman Province of Raetia. The location is a few miles west of the Castra Regina (Regensburg).
